title: Kaise bhule tuje bhala
body:
Kaise bhule tuje bhala
haye akbar haye akbar haye haye akbar (4)
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Duniya Me Hai Kaha tere jaisa akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko hai yeh khabar kya haal hai tera
tu laal hai mera
maa hu mai mujhse na chupa zakhm apna akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Girte the baarha uththe the baarha
dikhta hi kuch na tha
sheh ne haatho se der tak ran me dhunda akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila ki maamta zainab ki hasrate
sugra ki mannate
katl kitno ko kargaya ek naiza akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kya din hai raat kya kya dard kya dawa
kuch yad kab raha
yaad sughra ko reh gaya tera chehra akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mabaap ki tarah behno ko bhi teri
armaan reh gaya
tere khu se hi bangaya tera sehra akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth dekh bekasi mushkil hai ye ghadi
jageer se teri
berida ja rahi hai ma shaamo kufa akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti rahi ye maa uthkar salam kar
aayi hai lash par
jisne atthara saal hai tujhko pala akbar
<<MINI>>
kaise bhule tujhe bhala umme laila akbar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
lasha tadap gaya akbar ye marsiya
ma ke labo pe tha
tere jaane se lut gayi ma ki duniya akbar
